title: NLX-GPT: A Model for Natural Language Explanations in Vision and Vision-Language Tasks

bias_targets.methodology: The paper uses a 'Retrieval-based Attack' framework to measure how susceptible the model is to statistical correlations and biases in the training data. It retrieves similar images or text queries and computes the average cosine intra-distance of the generated explanations to see if the model outputs generic, repetitive explanations (relying on data bias) rather than engaging in true visual reasoning.
